description: Get an app's database status and connection info (whether it's provisioned, frozen, etc.).
name: vibekit_database_status

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Database stats: tables, storage, and connection info.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Database Status
